name: Davy Hall — pond terrace and gabled facades

source_face_fingerprint_packet.decision: Byte-exact frozen copy of root-reconciled packet, validating all exterior and interior rings; stale prior hash retained only in historical studies.

native_refinement.basis: Root and Astra inspected all six native v8 views against supplied drone272; v8 remains rejected.
native_refinement.east_ridge_status: Root-authorized bounded photo interpretation; seven existing patch footprints unchanged. Source heights and gradients outside patches stay exact. West ridge interpretation remains61.4m.
native_refinement.glazing_status: Native-driven interpretation of tall narrow sashes and supplied arch rise; no width increase. Full-block horns beyond the head and sill removed.
native_refinement.door_transoms: Five transparent white stained glass blocks within existing reveals physically join thin door tops to upper panes; no opaque interior cap band.
native_refinement.v9_correction: Replace full-height white gable risers by top-only sloped caps over masonry; retain exact central door leaf plane X264; use pale front-only jambs and masonry deep returns.

material_reference_packet.decision: One coherent stone-brick field approximates observed coarse horizontal masonry courses; real product unresolved. Original deepslate-tile roof and pale quartz trim retained.

window_reveal.status: Individually bounded one-cell inset behind contacting front arch bevel; source opening dimensions quantized without widening.

evidence.supports: Seven white gables, four plain windows, gray walls, raised pond terrace and central open porch

uncertainties: Window positions are scaled from drone imagery, with about 1m uncertainty; 1.15m source width quantizes to 1m clear glazing at 2 blocks/m.
Seven east gables and four plain windows are directly observed. West roof projections remain provisional symmetry; west apertures are unresolved and are not mirrored.
56.25m entrance and deck level is a DEM/photo interpretation, not a building survey.
Four pale porch posts are interpreted support locations fitted to the actual retained source canopy and authored outer hood; exact post dimensions and registration remain unmeasured.
Ordinary quartz stairs approximate the round arches and thin fascia; original block shapes impose visible quarter/half-metre steps.
The rail substrate is unresolved; pale oak is Sol's painted-white appearance proxy, not an assertion of real wood species.

straight_wall_control.rule: Nearest row cell with one inward step return; wall-only regularization below unchanged retained roof caps; central canopy preserved.
straight_wall_control.west_basis: Median U103.3416 of ordinary measured west contour rows; root authorized below-eave regularization after native v9, without windows or roof alteration.
